left_align_selected_tensor_values: left align selected values in a batch of PyTorch tensors using a boolean mask
reshape_batch_with_padding: reshape a batch of tensors by selecting values with a mask and padding unused slots
compute_left_align_mask: compute a left alignment mask for batched tensor selection and reshaping operations
batch_reshape_with_precomputed_mask: batch reshape tensors using a precomputed left alignment mask to skip recomputation
select_and_pad_tensor_batch: select values from a tensor batch with a boolean mask and pad to uniform length
